sampling_algorithm: simple random sample WITHOUT replacement within each stratum; a sampled issue carries all of its prompts, tiers, languages, models and annotations
allocation_rule: min(n_h, max(1, ceiling(f * n_h))) per stratum
nesting_algorithm: one permutation per (replicate, stratum); every fraction is a PREFIX of that permutation, so smaller samples are subsets of larger ones within a replicate

tolerances.note: fixed before any result was inspected

not_a_bootstrap: ranges are across-subsample stability bands, not confidence intervals
